limitations: Synthetic intervention/background labels, not adjudicated real fraud, money laundering or production prevalence.
All final arms are fixed before generation; final results do not select, repair or retune a model.
The previous model is scored on the SAME new final, not compared with percentages from its different old final.
The two generator draws share recipes; identifier namespace separation does not establish independent real customers.
Benign controls include exact observable counterfactuals and matching event prefixes; unobserved intent is not recoverable perfectly.
Chronological splits can share prior account history and episode fragments; they are not independent-case holdouts.
P05 has >=100-day inactivity, so its prior90-day amount references can be missing even when lifetime history is available.
Episode any-hit recall means one positive event flag, not all rows detected, confirmed crime, or prevention.
First-flag delay is conditional on detected episodes; missed episodes are separately counted, not assigned zero delay.
Class-weighted supervised outputs are uncalibrated scores; no live ACTIVE artifact or application alert count is measured.

definitions.AMOUNT: Observed transaction amount in source currency; no IDR conversion.
definitions.AMOUNT_OVER_PRIOR_MEAN: Amount divided by the prior ninety-day mean; unknown below the 30-observation/30-day history gate.
definitions.AMOUNT_OVER_TRAIN_MEDIAN: Amount divided by the frozen training-observation median amount.
definitions.AMOUNT_Z_PRIOR: Amount deviation divided by prior ninety-day standard deviation; unknown below the history gate or with zero deviation.
definitions.CHANNEL_TRAIN_FREQUENCY: This channel's frequency in training observations; 0 for an unseen channel.
definitions.COUNT_R1H: Strictly earlier exact-time observations in the prior source-clock hour plus this row; unknown for day-only timestamps.
definitions.COUNT_R24H: Strictly earlier exact-time observations in the prior source-clock 24 hours plus this row; unknown for day-only timestamps.
definitions.DAYS_SINCE_PREV_OBSERVATION: Source-clock days since the latest strictly prior available observation.
definitions.DEBIT_VALUE_R24H: Their outgoing value plus this row's debit value; unknown for day-only timestamps.
definitions.DEVICE_FIRST_USE: 1 if the device has not appeared in this account's strictly prior available history; unknown when device/history is unavailable.
definitions.HISTORY_DAYS: Days since the account's first observed transaction; not account opening age.
definitions.IP_FIRST_USE: Same prior-history novelty observation for the IP address; the raw address is never a model input.
definitions.IS_DEBIT: 1 for an observed debit, 0 for a credit.
definitions.LOG_AMOUNT: Natural logarithm of one plus the observed amount.
definitions.MERCHANT_FIRST_USE: Same prior-history novelty observation for merchant identity; no merchant ownership or counterparty is inferred.
definitions.NO_BASELINE: 1 when fewer than 30 prior observations or fewer than 30 observed days are available; 0 otherwise.
definitions.PRIOR_COUNT_R30D: Prior observed transaction count over thirty source-clock days.
definitions.PRIOR_COUNT_R7D: Prior observed transaction count over seven source-clock days, excluding the current observation.
definitions.PRIOR_DEBIT_VALUE_R7D: Prior outgoing amount over seven source-clock days.
definitions.PRIOR_HISTORY_COUNT: Transactions strictly available before this observation; same-day ordering is unknown for day-only rows.
definitions.PRIOR_SMALL_COUNT_R7D: Prior transactions below the training amount's 25th percentile, over seven source-clock days.
definitions.PRIOR_VALUE_R30D: Their amount sum in the unchanged source currency.
definitions.PRIOR_VALUE_R7D: Their amount sum in the unchanged source currency; no FX conversion.
definitions.UTC_HOUR_COS: Cosine of UTC hour, only for an offset-known timestamp with intraday precision.
definitions.UTC_HOUR_SIN: Sine of UTC hour, only for an offset-known timestamp with intraday precision.

vocabulary.small_amount_definition: training observations' amount 25th percentile; descriptive, not a reporting threshold
